scenario: An independent recruiter intentionally imports a synthetic attributed transcript and a locally cropped-and-redacted synthetic conversation screenshot, binds both to one existing person and relationship, reviews exact evidence and atomic facts, preserves one conflicting availability statement as unresolved, restores the durable relationship Wiki after refresh, and receives a supported no-action result without external writes.
frozen_evidence: Wiki snapshot ead49469 with 22 governed references
prepared image sha256 a333a1f145e1ea7c89ca6935a9f3ffcd71ba0f3be505ec5b7da175f22e9e908c with crop 10-90, two masks, and continuous dark rows 33-150 and 869-975

review_plan.reason: The core claim is reduced reconstruction work and one trustworthy relationship state.
The flow processes private screenshots and text through identity, evidence, claims, retention, deletion, and Wiki projection.
The changed workspace and screenshot modal are responsive and include a phone critical path.
Remembered candidate words, uncertainty, quiet, and future follow-through can affect candidate trust.
The artifact does not assess, compare, rank, score, or recommend candidates.

findings.observation: The authenticated executable flow turns either one reviewed screenshot or one explicitly attributed transcript into the same person-and-relationship page, exact source ledger, fact decisions, durable Wiki, and intentional no-action result. The evidence is synthetic and has not been compared with a working recruiter's current chat, notes, ATS, and calendar fallback.
findings.evidence: Working-tree code artifact 93d3320211a660082721dcd80f4cc1398170ce1760bb503cfcd5f8faeb504204; browser run on /workspace for capture 40c98a97-2be1-4552-93d8-c92304bd0110; synthetic-candidate-conversation.txt and live-model synthetic screenshot; locally minimized capture eb8c2254-e6ec-4ff7-8596-c824784e4660; Wiki snapshot ead49469 with 22 governed references; web 143 tests and backend 105 tests passed.
findings.user_impact: The loop is operationally complete and avoids duplicate relationship reconstruction, but claims that it saves time or prevents a missed candidate window remain unproven in real search work.
findings.recommendation: Run a five-minute pre-call reconstruction comparison with independent recruiters using their normal fallback and the same consented episode.
findings.verification: In at least five consented cases, measure time to recover the current relationship, seeded-error correction, duplicate-entry rate, unnecessary outreach avoided, and whether the Wiki changes the next real step.

strengths: Screenshot and transcript intake require only intentional source selection, explicit identity, explicit relationship context, and review proportionate to risk.
The recruiter can inspect exact messages, correct speaker attribution, confirm, edit, dismiss, or leave a proposal unresolved without accepting a summary bundle.
One person and one relationship context survive additional sources; the tested screenshot reused the original context instead of creating a duplicate relationship.
The latest published Wiki restores after refresh, and the screenshot-source bridge deep-links and focuses the exact fact-review section.
No-action remains a complete result while one availability statement is unresolved; the interface does not manufacture a reminder or meeting.
A mistakenly attached synthetic source was deleted through the rendered UI, and its governed derivatives disappeared while audit-safe identifiers remained.
missing_evidence: Working-recruiter comparison against the current manual fallback.
Measured day-later return across devices rather than same-browser refresh.
Observed action and candidate outcomes from a consented real workflow.
open_questions: Which source type should be the fastest default for an independent recruiter's actual post-call routine?
How often should the durable Wiki recompile automatically after a recruiter decision versus wait for explicit intent?

reviews.lens: evidence integrity, privacy, and safe action

findings.observation: The implementation sends only the user-kept image region, requests ZDR routing and data-collection denial, stores no original image, retains reviewed text with an explicit source receipt, and supports authorization revocation and deletion. Repository and browser evidence cannot independently verify provider deletion, infrastructure backups, or every operational log outside the tested application boundary.
findings.evidence: Code artifact 93d3320211a660082721dcd80f4cc1398170ce1760bb503cfcd5f8faeb504204; OpenRouter request policy in screenshot-analysis.ts; visible 30-day reviewed-text disclosure; live cropped-and-redacted analysis request gen-1786215853-1CW6441cvjEyRHr8dZFg; browser-local byte probe a333a1f145e1ea7c89ca6935a9f3ffcd71ba0f3be505ec5b7da175f22e9e908c; UI deletion of capture eb8c2254-e6ec-4ff7-8596-c824784e4660; backend deletion, authorization, restart-recovery, and resource lifecycle tests.
findings.user_impact: The product boundary is truthful in the tested application, but production privacy claims about every processor, backup, and log would exceed the available evidence.
findings.recommendation: Keep vendor and backup claims out of the UI until an operational retention inventory, processor configuration check, and deletion-monitoring run exist.
findings.verification: For a consented canary source, record the application, provider, logs, caches, backup class, deletion request, deletion completion, and monitoring result; no raw or derived content may remain beyond its disclosed scope.

strengths: Identity binding requires an explicit existing or new person decision and then an explicit existing or new relationship-context decision; the model cannot create or select either silently.
Speaker attribution is explicit and editable. Unknown or recruiter messages cannot compile candidate claims, and actor-aware backend tests cover that boundary.
Every confirmed or unresolved fact points to an exact message, quote, source identifier, model/prompt metadata, and append-only review state.
The screenshot provider treats image text as untrusted data, returns proposal-only structured output, and local schema validation rejects unsupported shapes.
A conflicting semantic availability value remained unresolved while the existing confirmed 2026-09-15 fact stayed visible; no destructive overwrite or action was produced.
Source authorization, retention scope, deletion, Wiki invalidation/rebuild, stale decisions, and idempotent operations are represented by executable contracts rather than policy copy alone.

The browser supports freeform local masks inside the retained crop. Two masks were flattened before upload, produced continuous dark pixel ranges 33–150 and 869–975, and were recorded with crop and redaction counts in signed provenance.
No candidate quality, fit, personality, protected trait, sentiment, or acceptance probability is inferred or displayed.
missing_evidence: Provider-side retention and deletion attestation for the configured route.
Backup, observability, analytics, and cache lifecycle proof outside application tests.
Cross-tenant penetration testing and monitored authorization-denial evidence.
open_questions: Which third-party and group-chat fixtures should become mandatory regression cases for local masking?
Which reviewed evidence fields need export in addition to deletion for candidate-rights handling?

reviews.lens: human connection, trust, agency, communication, collaboration

findings.observation: The private workspace preserves exact candidate words, uncertainty, ownership, quiet no-action, and recruiter review before any follow-through. The evaluated people and conversations are synthetic, so no candidate or candidate advisor has confirmed that the remembered wording and timing would feel accurate and respectful in a real search.
findings.evidence: Code artifact 93d3320211a660082721dcd80f4cc1398170ce1760bb503cfcd5f8faeb504204; synthetic text and screenshot episodes; durable Wiki ead49469; availability left unresolved; no-action block; no message, notification, meeting, or ATS effect executed.
findings.user_impact: The design avoids obvious pressure and false empathy, but it cannot yet claim that the resulting continuity improves a candidate's real experience.
findings.recommendation: Review the fact labels, uncertainty language, quiet state, and any future follow-up preview with candidates or candidate advisors before using outcome claims.
findings.verification: Participants must correctly identify what the candidate actually said, what remains uncertain, who owns the next step, whether anyone will contact them, and how an error can be corrected or deleted.

findings.observation: The recruiter can correct, dismiss, revoke, and delete evidence, but the reviewed internal surface does not yet provide a candidate-facing request or notice handoff for correction, access, or deletion.
findings.evidence: Rendered workspace controls include fact correction, source authorization, and deletion; candidate-facing account, notice delivery, and rights-request workflows are outside this slice.
findings.user_impact: A candidate who learns that a conversation was captured would depend on the recruiter's existing process to request correction or deletion.
findings.recommendation: Before production use with real candidate data, connect the governed source receipt to a plain-language rights-request operating path without exposing other candidates or recruiter-only analysis.
findings.verification: A synthetic candidate-rights request must locate the correct scoped source, export only authorized material, correct or delete it, rebuild dependent Wiki state, and return a truthful completion receipt.

strengths: Silence and uncertainty never become rejection, low engagement, or an acceptance prediction.
No-action is treated as a successful, calm outcome rather than an excuse to send another message.
Recruiter-authored and candidate-authored messages remain visibly distinct, preventing internal words from being presented as candidate intent.
The unresolved availability duplicate blocks a new action instead of converting availability into meeting consent.
Automation removes transcription and reconstruction work while every relationship judgment remains human-owned.
The interface uses specific source-linked language and avoids generic praise, faux empathy, coercive urgency, and person scoring.
missing_evidence: Candidate or candidate-advisor comprehension of the Wiki language and retention disclosure.
A production candidate-rights request, correction, export, and deletion operating path.
Candidate-facing message preview, delivery, failure, and humane closure behavior, which remain out of scope.
open_questions: What plain-language notice is proportionate for intentional recruiter capture in each jurisdiction and channel?
When should a no-action state still remind the recruiter to communicate a promised update so quiet does not become ghosting?

reviews.lens: mobile task completion, visual hierarchy, accessibility, and recovery

findings.observation: The responsive executable route has semantic headings, skip navigation, an explicitly titled and described Radix modal, deterministic focus entry, bidirectional focus containment, Esc dismissal with opener restoration, fact-review focus after commit, keyboard-operable local masking, reduced-motion behavior, dark mode, text alternatives, a fixed mobile confirmation footer, and 44-pixel mobile targets. A real VoiceOver or switch-control task was not available in this browser-only run.
findings.evidence: Code artifact 93d3320211a660082721dcd80f4cc1398170ce1760bb503cfcd5f8faeb504204; Playwright 390x844 and 1440x1000 runs; workspace-local-redaction-final.png, workspace-local-redaction-mobile.png, and workspace-radix-modal-mobile.png; modal opened with the dialog itself active; Shift+Tab wrapped from Close to Cancel and Tab wrapped from Cancel to Close; Esc closed and restored the exact Import screenshot opener; capture 40c98a97-2be1-4552-93d8-c92304bd0110 loaded with #proposed-changes active; Enter added a local mask, arrows moved it, Shift+Arrow resized it, Delete restored the original canvas, and the live status announced both states; empty and prepared-state undersized-control audits returned []; dialog and body horizontal overflow were zero; clean console had zero errors or warnings.
findings.user_impact: Keyboard focus behavior is now directly proven, but announcement order and scanning behavior could still affect VoiceOver or switch-control users without being visible to browser semantics alone.
findings.recommendation: Run the screenshot crop, identity binding, evidence review, fact decision, Wiki, source deletion, and return path with VoiceOver and switch control on a supported device.
findings.verification: Identity, exact source, crop consequence, uncertainty, proposed fact, decision controls, deletion effect, and restored Wiki must be announced once in visual order; every action must be operable and focus must return to the invoking control.

findings.observation: The production build succeeds and the interactive development surface remained responsive during live model analysis and browser-local pixel preparation, but this artifact does not contain repeated throttled production traces for the authenticated workspace.
findings.evidence: Next.js production build succeeded; live cropped-and-redacted screenshot analysis reached evidence review in approximately seven seconds; the browser-local byte probe completed without network upload; no layout overflow or console failure was observed in the fresh browser session.
findings.user_impact: Slow-network users may experience longer analysis or first render than the direct local run proves.
findings.recommendation: Capture three authenticated mobile production traces with slow network and one network-loss retry before making a quantified performance claim.
findings.verification: Median first meaningful relationship content and analysis feedback meet an agreed budget, cancellation remains available where safe, retry does not duplicate a source, and CLS remains zero.

strengths: At 390 by 844 pixels, the fact-review deep link lands with the decision heading visible at 160 pixels, focus on the section, and zero horizontal overflow.
Every visible main-page and capture-modal control, including crop ranges, close, speaker choice, replace, and footer actions, measures at least 44 pixels in the tested mobile layout.
The confirmation footer remains visible at the bottom of the 390x844 dialog while the evidence preparation body scrolls independently.
The first viewport distinguishes one confirmed fact from one needs-clarification fact using text, border, label, and evidence rather than color alone.
The durable Wiki, no-action state, source lineage, and exact evidence remain coherent in light and dark themes.
Reduce Motion resolves scroll behavior to auto, and the deep link deliberately focuses the relevant review region after server rendering.
The browser-local crop and freeform masks visibly minimize the source, send a different byte hash, and show the exact analyzed pixels with a two-mask disclosure in the later review state.
Local masking is keyboard-operable: Enter adds, arrows move, Shift plus arrows resize, Delete undoes, and an aria-live status reports the current mask count.
The capture modal uses Radix focus management and directly proves initial focus, forward and reverse wrapping, Esc dismissal, opener restoration, and successful handoff to fact review.
Long identity text wraps without horizontal scrolling, and the missing portrait uses an explicitly unverified monogram instead of a guessed photo.
missing_evidence: VoiceOver, switch-control, browser zoom, and real-device safe-area completion.
Simplified Chinese localization expansion and RTL behavior.
Slow-network, offline, background/return, and browser termination during crop or evidence review.
open_questions: Should the fixed relationship Agent collapse by default after a deep link on the smallest phones?
Which portions of a partially prepared screenshot draft should resume after browser termination?

top_findings.next_step: Run the same consented episode through Talent Signal and each recruiter's current fallback.
top_findings.verification: At least five cases measure recovery time, seeded-error correction, duplicate work, unnecessary outreach, and changed next decisions.

top_findings.reason: Application controls are executable, but provider deletion, backups, and non-application logs are outside the current proof boundary.
top_findings.next_step: Run an operational retention and deletion canary across every processor and derived store.
top_findings.verification: No raw or derived content remains beyond the disclosed scope, and monitoring records the completed deletion path.

top_findings.reason: Browser focus containment, restoration, keyboard masking, and 44-pixel measurements cannot prove VoiceOver announcement order or switch-control scanning completion.
top_findings.next_step: Complete the crop-to-Wiki and deletion path with VoiceOver and switch control on a supported device.
top_findings.verification: Every identity, source, uncertainty, consequence, and action is announced once in visual order; focus and state survive the full task.

agreements: Screenshot and text sources bind to one explicit person and relationship rather than creating parallel contact truth.
Observed evidence, proposed interpretation, recruiter confirmation, durable Wiki, action intent, and outcome remain distinct.
No-action and unresolved evidence are complete states without manufactured urgency or external writes.
Source evidence, retention, authorization, and deletion controls are visible and executable from the relationship.
The visual system uses warm neutrals, editorial hierarchy, and scarce vermilion for review attention without ranking a person.
The implementation is ready for bounded field and assistive-technology testing, but not for unsupported 95-plus outcome claims.
adjudication.rationale: All four applicable reviewers return contract-valid 3 of 4 scores with direct executable evidence and no vetoes. Every defect found in the rendered implementation was corrected and retested: duplicate relationship creation, screenshot-to-fact deep linking, durable Wiki restoration, cloud-input cropping, browser-local freeform and keyboard-operable masking, Radix modal focus containment and restoration, fixed confirmation actions, mobile target size, responsive overflow, and provider connectivity. The pre-provider third-party minimization and browser keyboard gaps from earlier panels are resolved with byte, pixel, provenance, live-provider, focus, keyboard, and deletion proof. The gate remains needs_evidence because field usefulness, candidate comprehension, provider and backup lifecycle, real assistive-technology completion, and measured production performance require external evidence rather than more cosmetic iteration.
